title: Reviewing a Teammate's Branch
description: Check out a teammate's branch, inspect its changes against main, and return without modifying or merging anything.
objective: Inspect Priya's reporting branch and return to main without changing either branch.

whatToDo.text: Return to main without changing anything.

hints: You can check out another branch just to inspect its work without merging it.
Compare feature/reporting with main to see the changes introduced by the branch.
Return to main when your review is complete and leave both branches unchanged.

intro.message: Tom asked you to review Priya's reporting branch before he approves the pull request. Take a look at the work, but don't merge or modify anything.

checkoutBranch.message: Good. You're on Priya's branch now. Take a look through the work before heading back.

inspectChanges.message: Nice. You've inspected the branch changes. That gives us the context we need for the review.

returnToMain.message: Perfect. You're back on main and the review didn't alter either branch.

success.message: Good overview — that matches the PR description. Thanks for taking the time to actually look through it.

failure.message: The review isn't complete yet. Inspect the reporting branch, avoid changing its work, and return to main.
